headline: Supreme Court Invalidates Education Equivalency Certificate Of Gibran
seoTitle: Supreme Court Cancels Gibran Education Certificate
metaDescription: Indonesia's Supreme Court has ruled the high school equivalency certificate held by Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka as legally invalid and void.
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court declared the education equivalency certificate of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka void and legally invalid.
The Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education has been ordered by the Court to revoke the previously issued equivalency documentation.
Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra stated that the judicial decision is final, while political reactions highlight conflicting views on potential legal recourse.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian Supreme Court recently issued a ruling regarding the education equivalency certificate of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka. In case number 742 K/TUN/2026, the Court granted a cassation appeal filed by an individual named Subhan, ultimately determining that the certificate for Gibran's high school education is invalid and void by law. This decision incorporated considerations from previous Constitutional Court rulings. Following the announcement, Coordinating Minister for Legal, Human Rights, Immigration, and Correctional Affairs Yusril Ihza Mahendra affirmed that the Supreme Court's verdict is considered final. Meanwhile, members of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDIP) have questioned the appropriateness of any subsequent challenges through the Administrative Court (PTUN) regarding a final Supreme Court decision. The Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education is mandated to carry out the revocation of the specified educational document as per the judicial order.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant traction across multiple Indonesian news outlets due to the high-ranking official involved and the legal implications for his educational standing.
